notes.title: Knobbly Crook Patch 1.5
notes.content:
* Extended ending to end more cliff hang to the cliffhanger ending.
* Fixed two walkthrough breaks involving Pinbutter.
* Added a new song to the Cat Totem area.
* Changed the tutorial and pushed it into the main path if you haven't viewed the guide first (many people complained they had no idea how to play). 
* Added extra logic to using certain objects on things that make sense but didn't tell you why they wouldn't work.
* Updated the AGS engine to the current build. 
* Added a little bit more retaliation from the end boss.
* Fixed a bug that was disabling end pins.
* Added a little bit more time to read the squid lines.
* A few typo fixes and rewording to better set up the clues.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
The Knobbly Crook should now update to 1.1, which includes many useful features requested by your feedback. They are:

* Slower Talking - I've added an extra bit of space into every spoken line to give slower readers a chance to keep up with the Knobbcrookians. 
* Punctuation fixes! Exciting! 
* Fixed missing audio files. 
* Cleaned the colon extractor, but it's already dirty again. Oh well. 
* Added Hotkeys - 1 = Walk, 2 = Look, 3 = Use, 4 = Talk, 5 = Take, 6 (or Tab) = Inventory
* Updated cursors to better differentiate use and take.
* Volume sliders for Speech, Sound, and Music. 
* Ability to turn on and off mouseover room exit icons. You will only see them in rooms where you have walk-into exits. Exits that are found with other interaction icons will not show up here (because spoilers). 
* Extended Music and Sound credits have been moved into the credits screen rather than in text files. 
* Fixed a walk-behind issue in the Captain's room that put O'Sirus inside the walkway.
